name: Databases-II
description: AgroClima: plataforma de monitoreo climático y predicción de riesgos agrícolas con PostgreSQL y MongoDB, ingesta desde OpenWeather, predicción por reglas y dashboard en Streamlit.

paragraphs: AgroClima is a climate monitoring and agricultural risk prediction platform developed for the Databases II course at Universidad Distrital Francisco José de Caldas. It covers the full data lifecycle: business model and requirements, relational and NoSQL data architecture, real-time ingestion from a weather API, rule-based event prediction, recommendations and an interactive dashboard.

AgroClima is a smart agro-climatic decision support platform designed to provide advanced climate-based solutions for farmers and agricultural organizations. The core idea is to leverage climate data and artificial intelligence tools to deliver accurate and timely recommendations that enhance agricultural decision-making in the face of adverse weather conditions.

The platform addresses the high vulnerability of the agricultural sector to extreme weather events such as droughts, frosts, and heavy rainfall, which result in substantial crop losses, reduced productivity, and threats to food security. Currently, many farmers lack effective and accessible tools to anticipate and adapt to these challenges.
features: Relational model in PostgreSQL (AgroClimaDB.sql) plus a MongoDB document model for raw API responses and user interaction logs.
Ingestion pipeline that pulls live data from the OpenWeather API.
Rule-based detection of drought, flood, frost, hailstorm and landslide events with a severity-based probability.
Automatic agronomic recommendations for each prediction.
Streamlit dashboard with filters by location and event type.
